originality.rationale: The primary 2026 article gives the theta–partition generating functions and deformation invariance but no leading asymptotic for the second grading or precise real-versus-complex growth ratio; its HTML was read across the introduction, sections 6–8, tables and references, and a text search for asymptotic claims found none. The preceding 2022/2026-version article treats del Pezzo K^2>0 and growth in the first index, not this K^2=0 second-index regime. Bryan–Leung supplies only a fixed-section product. The new proof isolates a second potential dominant eta cusp and proves its exact theta cancellation, fixing the leading constants. Published-record and prior-statement comparisons did not show covering statements, subject to the risks below.
residual_risks: A broad modular-form coefficient theorem may contain an implicit specialization once the specific theta–eta product and cusp cancellation are supplied; no explicit covering geometric theorem was found.
Original full text of the older Bryan–Leung article was not inspected; only its relevant theorem as quoted in the 2026 article and its public abstract.
Semantic searches do not prove global originality or access unpublished work.
